title: Discriminate source warning-stderr refusal reasons and prevent payload echo in tests
outcome: Behavioral source-warning refusal tests distinguish the stderr gate and verify private or control payloads never appear in the refusal diagnostic.
acceptance: Unsupported warning-stderr cases assert the stderr-specific refusal reason and absence of private content, BOM and terminal escapes from errors.
An exit-1 well-formed unavailable envelope plus a supported warning distinguishes the status-0-only warning gate; the completed-envelope exit control does not stand in for this case.
Existing valid-warning admission and malformed-envelope refusal behavior remains covered without tests of repository Markdown or instruction text.
